title: Tax Invoice
key_sentences: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
Please quote the invoice number as the reference on every payment so that we can match it to your account.

Thank you for choosing Harbourline again this season.
If you have any questions about this invoice, please contact our accounts team.
